name: history-of-europe-in-frames
description: European history on maps, told scene by scene in one offline HTML file.

scripts.vercel-build: cd src && python3 assemble.py ../index.html && mkdir -p ../dist && cp ../index.html ../dist/index.html
scripts.test: for f in tests/verify-*.js; do node "$f" index.html || exit 1; done
